evidence.observation: Sunrise menu with New Game, How to Play and Quit; no Load Game on an empty save folder.
evidence.riff: Load Game only appears once a save exists.

evidence.observation: How to Play lists 11 controls and 7 survival rules.
evidence.riff: The same controls are in the README.

evidence.observation: Three intro pages, each advanced with Continue.
evidence.riff: The story sets the deadline before play starts.

evidence.observation: Captured-mouse look around the village at 07:30.
evidence.riff: Look is relative mouse motion, clamped in pitch.

evidence.observation: I opens a 21-slot inventory and frees the cursor.
evidence.riff: Windows stop look and selection while open.

evidence.observation: C shows the Axe recipe at 3 Gold [0], 3 Stick [0], no Craft button.
evidence.riff: The button only exists when the recipe is affordable.

evidence.observation: Pressing 1 without an axe shows "Craft an axe first [C]".
evidence.riff: A refusal that teaches the next step.

evidence.observation: E on an orchard tree adds an Apple.
evidence.riff: Each tree holds three apples, saved with the game.

evidence.observation: The stick name appears under the crosshair; E collects it with a pickup popup.
evidence.riff: Reach is 4 m from the screen centre.

evidence.observation: The objective list ticks "Gather 3 Sticks".
evidence.riff: Objectives refresh twice a second from the inventory.

evidence.observation: Calories fall while walking (100 to 76 by 09:07).
evidence.riff: One calorie per 5 m walked.

evidence.observation: Gold nuggets lie beside the split ore rocks.
evidence.riff: A placement hint, not a marker.

evidence.observation: Three stones picked up near the standing stones.
evidence.riff: Stones also ring the lake.

evidence.observation: Tools tab; Craft Axe consumes 3 Gold + 3 Stick.
evidence.riff: The Unity recipe, kept.

evidence.observation: Key 1 equips the axe; it appears in the hand and the HUD.
evidence.riff: Right-click in the inventory also equips.

evidence.observation: Four left-click swings fell a pine; the prompt counts hits left.
evidence.riff: Uses the swing and chop sounds Unity declared.

evidence.observation: A felled pine leaves a stump and two spinning Logs.
evidence.riff: Dropped items spin; placed ones do not.

evidence.observation: Ticked objectives read "(0/3)" after the axe consumed the sticks and gold.
evidence.riff: Counters read the current inventory, not what was gathered.

evidence.observation: Survival tab; Craft Campfire consumes 4 Log + 3 Stone.
evidence.riff: Authored recipe; no Unity counterpart.

evidence.observation: A rabbit flees; one axe hit plays its Dead clip and drops meat.
evidence.riff: Seen in motion, which the GDD lists as unreviewed (R-04).

evidence.observation: Aiming at the lake and pressing E restores water to 100.
evidence.riff: The lake is a ray target, not a pickup.

evidence.observation: "You can't build a fire in the water"; the campfire stays in the inventory.
evidence.riff: The spot is 2.6 m ahead of the player.

evidence.observation: Right-click the campfire on dry ground: lit, with light and particles.
evidence.riff: Placing closes the inventory.

evidence.observation: Cooked Meat crafts only with a campfire within 9 m.
evidence.riff: The recipe checks the fire distance.

evidence.observation: Hovering a slot shows name, description and function.
evidence.riff: Ported from InventoryItem.cs.

evidence.observation: Dragging an item to the last slot moves it, with a preview.
evidence.riff: Onto a full slot it would swap.

evidence.observation: Right-click eats Cooked Meat, Apple and Mushroom; calories 35 → 100.
evidence.riff: Each effect is clamped to 100.

evidence.observation: M pauses: Resume, Save Game, Settings, Main Menu, Quit Game.
evidence.riff: The HUD hides while paused.

evidence.observation: Settings shows mouse sensitivity and volume sliders.
evidence.riff: Opened, not changed.

evidence.observation: Save Game → Save writes the one slot ("Game saved.").
evidence.riff: One JSON file; saving overwrites.

evidence.observation: Load Game restores 13:09 with the fire placed.
evidence.riff: Position, inventory, flags and fires come back.

evidence.observation: The sky blends to sunset and the light falls.
evidence.riff: Three skybox panoramas blended by a shader.

evidence.observation: "Night falls. Stay by your fire." at 20:00.
evidence.riff: Night runs at 12 s per hour.

evidence.observation: No cold beside the fire at night.
evidence.riff: Warmth radius 9 m.

evidence.observation: E at the fire: "You rest by the fire...", time runs 9× faster.
evidence.riff: Resting skips the dull part of the night.

evidence.observation: Dawn Breaks: day 2, 16 items, 2 trees felled, 1 rabbit.
evidence.riff: Victory needs dawn and a night near the fire.

evidence.observation: Back at the main menu, Load Game is offered.
evidence.riff: The save outlives the run.

evidence.observation: Synthetic pad: right stick looks; Y opens and closes the inventory.
evidence.riff: Same actions as keyboard, bound in code.

evidence.observation: Away from the fire: "You are freezing!" and a blue overlay.
evidence.riff: Cold damages 1 health per 1.4 s.

evidence.observation: N takes 10 health a press.
evidence.riff: Kept from Unity's PlayerState debug key.

evidence.observation: Below 25 health the bar pulses.
evidence.riff: A late warning.

evidence.observation: Lost to the Wilds: "You froze in the night", with Load Save.
evidence.riff: The cause is named.

evidence.observation: Load Save returns to the night save beside the fire.
evidence.riff: Defeat is recoverable.

not_exercised.reason: F11 toggles fullscreen; not captured, because it would change the fixed capture window.
The Quit buttons were not clicked.
Play Again on the end screens was not clicked.
The Settings sliders were shown but not moved.
Red Cap, Bread and the Water Flask were not picked up or eaten.
Sprint and jump appear only inside movement, not as a separate demonstration.
The game has synthesized sounds and music; game audio was not captured. Narration only.
